aiReview.summary: The package is an inert semantic-color theme whose manifest contains literal hexadecimal colors and bounded host-owned presentation presets. The supplied deterministic report passed with no warnings, and the manifest identity and hash agree with that report. The declared notnote provenance, pinned revision, MIT licensing, palette, typography, journal-header styling, and documented task-summary limitation are supported by the supplied upstream materials. No executable theme code, dependencies, build hooks, graph access, protocol operations, or unsafe transformations are present.
